passages.title: Text 1: Dina's Weekend
passages.text: Hi! My name is Dina. I am thirteen years old and I live in Surabaya with my parents and my little brother, Raka. On Saturday morning, I usually help my mother at home. In the afternoon, I play badminton with my friends in the park near our house. On Sunday, my family visits my grandmother. She cooks delicious fried rice for us. I love weekends because I can relax and spend time with my family.

items.q: How old is Dina?
Who does Dina live with?
What does Dina do on Saturday afternoon?
Where does Dina go on Sunday?
Why does Dina love weekends?
o: She can relax and spend time with her family.
She can play games all day.

passages.title: Text 2: The Phone Rule at Bima's School
passages.text: Last year, Bima's school introduced a new rule: students must leave their phones in a locker during lessons. At first, many students were unhappy. Bima said, "I use my phone to check the dictionary, so this rule is not fair." However, after two months, his teacher noticed that students paid more attention in class and talked to each other more during breaks. Test scores in English also went up a little. Today, most students agree that the rule is useful, although some still want to use their phones for learning activities. The school is now thinking about allowing phones in special projects, with the teacher's permission.

items.q: What is the new rule?
o: Students cannot bring phones to school.
Students must keep their phones in a locker during lessons.
Students can use phones only in the library.
Students must use phones for the dictionary.

items.q: At first, many students were ___.
What changed after two months?
o: Students paid more attention and talked more during breaks.

items.q: Why do some students still want to use phones?
What is the school thinking about now?
o: Allowing phones in special projects with the teacher's permission
Banning phones from the whole school
Letting students use phones at any time

d.instr: Tekan tombol putar untuk mendengarkan. Setiap rekaman bisa diputar 2 kali. Lalu jawab soalnya.

clips.title: Rekaman 1: Dialog
script: Hi, Tono. What are you doing this afternoon?
I'm going to the library. I need a book for my science project.
Can I come with you? I want to return a book.
Sure! The library closes at four o'clock, so let's go at two.
Okay. I'll meet you in front of the school gate at two.

items.q: Where is Tono going this afternoon?
Why does Tono need a book?
Why does Sari want to go to the library?
What time does the library close?
Where will Sari and Tono meet?
o: In front of the school gate

clips.title: Rekaman 2: Pengumuman
script: Good morning, everyone. This is an announcement about English Day next Friday. The event will start at eight o'clock in the school hall, not on the field as we planned before, because the weather may be rainy. Every class will perform a short drama in English. Each drama must be no longer than five minutes. Please bring your costumes and props on Thursday afternoon, and give them to Mrs. Lestari in the teachers' room. Students who bring food and drinks should keep them outside the hall. Thank you, and good luck!

items.q: What is the announcement about?
Why was the place changed to the school hall?
o: The teachers like the hall better.

items.q: How long can each drama be?
When should students bring their costumes and props?
Who should receive the costumes and props?

tasks.title: Tugas 1 (wajib)
tasks.prompt: Write 3 to 5 sentences about yourself. You can write about your name, your age, your family, and what you like to do.

tasks.title: Tugas 2 (jika kamu mampu)
tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph (about 60 to 80 words) about your best friend or your favourite activity at school. Say what you do, when you do it, and why you like it.
